title: Eligibility-Period Alignment of Single Referral Visits (Primary Care Provider Assignment)
content:
**Primary Care Provider Assignment — single specialist referrals and the member's eligibility period.**

**Clause.** The visit total of a single specialist referral — its core visits together with every visit added to them — is aligned to the member's eligibility period, read from the status and renewal due date of the member's **Medicaid Managed Care Membership**:

1. while the plan membership is in **renewal-due** status, the visit total is multiplied by the calendar days from the handling date to the renewal due date and divided by the practice type's referral validity days;
2. while the plan membership is **active** and its renewal due date is **fewer than 12 whole months** after the handling date, the visit total is multiplied by those whole months and divided by 12;
3. in every other case the visit total is not aligned.

The aligned product is rounded down to a whole visit, and the single-referral visit ceiling is applied to that rounded figure.

**Input, judgement, output (hypothetical inputs; visit total 9, handling date 15 September 2026)**

| Membership status | Renewal due date | Judgement | Aligned visits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Renewal-due | 15 November 2026 (61 calendar days) | Days-based; with 180 referral validity days, 9 multiplied by 61 and divided by 180 is 3.05 | 3 |
| Active | 1 March 2027 (5 whole months) | Months-based: 9 multiplied by 5 and divided by 12 is 3.75 | 3 |
| Active | 20 August 2027 (11 whole months) | Months-based: 9 multiplied by 11 and divided by 12 is 8.25 | 8 |
| Active | 1 October 2027 (12 whole months) | Not fewer than 12: not aligned | 9 |
| Reconsideration | Any | Neither branch: not aligned | 9 |
